head_commit.message:
Avoid network delay in local_git_branches by using cached remote info

When refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD is missing, get_default_branch() falls
back to `git remote show <remote>` which contacts the remote. This can
block for up to 5 seconds per remote in offline or auth-gated repos,
stalling the interactive /review branch picker.

Introduce NetworkMode enum to control whether network access is allowed
when querying git remotes. local_git_branches() now uses LocalOnly mode
which adds the `-n` flag to `git remote show`, using only cached info.
